sources.title: MITRE ATT&CK Version History and August 2026 Updates
reviewTriggers: ATT&CK major or minor release
Used Object version, modified, revoked/deprecated or relationship change
sources.notes: Version History identifies current v19.2 but retains an April 28 date; Updates gives August 6, 2026. Release published_at is 2026-08-05T22:57:35Z. Fixed CTI commit 8543c5b05bd9bbcace9fc37f30bba96b675b6f33; enterprise SHA-256 f7eaf37fe53b50404084fe1fe67237278f7317e61c11ad550295722d13ede259. Chapter 5 uses this current snapshot. Chapter 17 uses behavior mapping not coverage proof; Chapter 25 retains its historical v19.1 sentence and uses ATT&CK not as attribution proof. Those bounded meanings were checked unchanged, not a claim of full reauthoring of other chapters. Chapter 5 source review records this migration. publishedAt is null because the live Version History page does not establish its own publication timestamp. The related release UTC timestamp and Updates effective/start date above are separate context, not the publication date of this live page. Publication date of the live page is unknown; monitor Version History and Updates on the recorded review triggers rather than guessing a date. Chapter 6 scoped re-audit on 2026-09-12 preserves the inherited v19.2 mapping and the distinction between strategy and observed coverage; no parent observation/control is promoted.

The Components are used as a common vocabulary and decomposition aid, not as standalone proof of individual competence. sources.notes: 2026-08-08にNIST CSWP 29 final publication pageと現行Resource Centerを意味確認した。第4章ではBusiness Outcome、Governance、Risk communicationへのHandoffを支える高位Outcome taxonomyとして用いる。CSFは実装方法を規定せず、mappingはThreat Model、Control実装、観測、有効性または完全性の証明ではない。

sources.title: Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
reviewTriggers: NIST SP 800-30 revision, withdrawal, successor, or errata
NIST Risk Management publications index status change
Change to a threat source, threat event, vulnerability, predisposing condition, likelihood, impact, or uncertainty concept used by Chapter 4
sources.notes: 2026-08-08に公式final publication pageとNIST Risk Management publications indexを意味確認した。確認した公式範囲ではRev.1はFinalとして掲載され、後継版または専用errataは確認できなかった。第4章ではRisk assessmentの準備・維持、Threat source/event、Vulnerability/Predisposing condition、Likelihood、Impact、Uncertainty、Decision handoffの限定概念だけに用いる。Federal向けProcessを普遍的必須手順とせず、数値Risk scoreをThreat Modelの完了条件にしない。

sources.title: OWASP Threat Modeling Project
reviewTriggers: OWASP project status or methodology-neutral guidance change
OWASP Threat Modeling Project resource, tool, or historical-material classification change
Project URL relocation or retirement
sources.notes: 2026-08-08に公式Project pageを意味確認し、Maintained Project Guidanceであることと単一の公式OWASP Threat Modeling methodologyを定義しないことを確認した。継続更新されるProject pageには固定versionと単一published dateが提示されていないため、versionとpublishedAtは推測せずnullとする。checkedAt、nextReviewAt、reviewTriggersで現行pageとProject statusを追跡し、公式に固定version、公開日またはreleaseが提示された場合に再監査する。第4章では方法論中立の補助参照としてのみ用いる。STRIDE、Diagram、Toolまたは生成件数はThreat Modelの完全性、Control有効性または評価品質の証明ではない。
